mapper.select: SELECT km.knowledge_point_id, AVG(CASE km.mastery_level WHEN '优秀' THEN 95 WHEN '良好' THEN 80 WHEN '一般' THEN 65 WHEN '较差' THEN 40 ELSE 0 END) AS average_mastery_rate FROM knowledge_mastery km JOIN knowledge_points kp ON km.knowledge_point_id = kp.id JOIN class_students cs ON km.student_id = cs.student_id WHERE 1=1 AND kp.course_id = #{courseId} AND cs.class_id = #{classId} AND km.student_id = #{studentId} AND km.knowledge_point_id = #{knowledgePointId} GROUP BY km.knowledge_point_id

SELECT kp.id, kp.point_name AS pointName, kp.description, kp.difficulty, kp.order_index AS orderIndex, kp.course_id AS courseId FROM knowledge_points kp JOIN assignment_knowledge_points akp ON kp.id = akp.knowledge_point_id WHERE akp.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY kp.order_index

SELECT kp.id, kp.point_name AS pointName, kp.description, kp.difficulty, kp.order_index AS orderIndex, kp.course_id AS courseId FROM knowledge_points kp JOIN exam_knowledge_points ekp ON kp.id = ekp.knowledge_point_id WHERE ekp.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY kp.order_index

SELECT asub.student_id AS studentId, asub.score, a.max_score AS maxScore, a.id AS assignmentId, a.title AS assignmentTitle FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id JOIN assignment_knowledge_points akp ON a.id = akp.assignment_id WHERE akp.knowledge_point_id = #{knowledgePointId} AND asub.graded = 1 AND asub.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT esub.student_id AS studentId, esub.score, 100 AS maxScore, e.id AS examId, e.title AS examTitle FROM exam_submissions esub JOIN exams e ON esub.exam_id = e.id JOIN exam_knowledge_points ekp ON e.id = ekp.exam_id WHERE ekp.knowledge_point_id = #{knowledgePointId} AND esub.graded = 1 AND esub.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT km.student_id AS studentId, km.knowledge_point_id AS knowledgePointId, kp.point_name AS pointName, kp.difficulty, km.mastery_level AS masteryLevel, km.last_assessed_date AS lastAssessedDate FROM knowledge_mastery km JOIN knowledge_points kp ON km.knowledge_point_id = kp.id WHERE km.student_id = #{studentId} AND kp.course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT kp.id AS knowledgePointId, kp.point_name AS pointName, kp.difficulty, COUNT(DISTINCT km.student_id) AS totalStudents, SUM(CASE WHEN km.mastery_level = '优秀' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN km.mastery_level = '良好' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodCount, SUM(CASE WHEN km.mastery_level = '一般' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS averageCount, SUM(CASE WHEN km.mastery_level = '较差' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poorCount FROM knowledge_points kp LEFT JOIN knowledge_mastery km ON kp.id = km.knowledge_point_id WHERE kp.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY kp.id, kp.point_name, kp.difficulty ORDER BY kp.order_index
